g.text: 11 Forward requests to Gateway in the selected Control Pod
Control and Supervisor alone mount scoped Kubernetes API credentials. Serving has no API token or application DB.
Application roles mount ml-runtime and use bounded artifact caches. Serving uses emptyDir. Minikube postgres hosts app and MLflow databases.
Peer infra traffic uses Services. Role Secret / CA projections are copied to private files by role-specific init containers.
Singleton Recreate is implemented. Production CSI, multi-node recovery, network-policy enforcement and HA remain unqualified.
